Fix webhook signature verification failure in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`; customers are getting 400s. Pagination work is paused/superseded.

## Plan and progress
Disputed-order step 3 done: validation passed for 7 orders. Steps 4–8 pending. Pagination and related billing refactors/tests passed. Next: `sed -n '1,240p' ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`
